description: This file declares the API functions for OVSDB synchronization, including select, insert, update, delete, and upsert operations, with support for parent-child relationships and UUID handling.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_where_simple
methods.description: Creates a simple where clause JSON object based on column and value.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_where_simple_typed
methods.description: Creates a typed where clause JSON object based on column, value, and column type.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_where_uuid
methods.description: Creates a where clause JSON object based on UUID.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_where_multi
methods.description: Creates a composite where clause JSON object from multiple conditions.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_mutation
methods.description: Creates a mutation JSON object for a specified column.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_get_update_result_count
methods.description: Returns the count of update results for a given table and operation.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_get_insert_result_uuid
methods.description: Retrieves the UUID of an inserted row.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_sync_select_where
methods.description: Performs a select operation with a where clause on the specified OVSDB socket path.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_sync_select
methods.description: Performs a simple select operation on a table with a column-value filter.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_sync_insert
methods.description: Inserts a row into the specified table via OVSDB socket.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_sync_delete_where
methods.description: Deletes rows matching the where clause from the specified table.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_sync_update_where
methods.description: Updates rows matching the where clause in the specified table.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_sync_update
methods.description: Updates a specific column with a value in the specified table.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_sync_update_one_get_uuid
methods.description: Updates a row and retrieves its UUID.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_sync_upsert_where
methods.description: Performs an upsert (update or insert) based on a where clause.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_sync_upsert
methods.description: Performs an upsert based on column and value.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_sync_mutate_uuid_set
methods.description: Mutates a UUID set in a row.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_sync_insert_with_parent
methods.description: Inserts a row with a parent relationship.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_sync_upsert_with_parent
methods.description: Upserts a row with a parent relationship.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_sync_delete_with_parent
methods.description: Deletes a row with a parent relationship.
